modes.auto: Require admitted resolved @stencil/core package role and file-local canonical decorator symbols
modes.on: Explicitly request Stencil but still require an admitted resolved package role and canonical decorator identity
modes.off: Inactive; zero adapter, TypeInfo, index, tsgo or contributor work

row.fileEvidence: Decorators resolved through TS symbols to @stencil/core; @Component establishes a component class
row.selection: FWA1 record selects exactly one framework; a package in the workspace alone never claims all .tsx files

identity.aliases: Resolve imported aliases/re-exports to the canonical declaration

ordinaryInputs.role: ordinary TS type input; stale or missing reported, never regenerated
static CENV1C outputTargets facts; computed values unknown; not activation authority

unknownOrUnsupported: Unadmitted or unresolved release is unsupported with reason, never forced active
